secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Credentials owned by {{project}}, kept in the system keychain of this computer. Tools and MCP servers select the ones they need; agents never see a value.

uses.heading: USED BY · {{uses}}
uses.empty: No tool or MCP server uses this secret yet. Select it in a tool’s Credentials settings or an MCP server’s configuration.

secrets.recentHint: Access to secrets is recorded once tools can use them. No tool can use a secret in this version yet.
secrets.archivedHint: This secret is archived. Its value was removed from the system keychain. These resources still refer to its archived name.
secrets.loadFailureDetail: Reading the secrets from the project database failed: {{reason}} No secret was changed, and no value was read. The list appears once it can be read.
secrets.emptyDetail: Add the credentials this project’s tools and MCP servers need. A value is kept in the system keychain of this computer, never in the project folder, and is not shown again after saving.
secrets.environmentEmptyDetail: Add one, or choose another environment above.
secrets.usageDetail: Access to secrets is recorded once tools can use them. No tool can use a secret in this version yet.
secrets.usageWho: Who asked: the tool or MCP server, with the run and step
secrets.usageOutcome: The decision, the time and the outcome
secrets.usageNever: Never the value of a secret

form.title: New secret
form.subtitle: {{project}} · not saved yet
form.name: Name
form.valueHint: The value is hidden after saving. Replace it later to rotate the credential.
form.takenValueHint: The value is hidden after saving. Use Replace value to rotate a saved secret.
form.projectNote: · new secrets go to the current project
form.notice: After saving, select it in a tool’s Credentials settings or an MCP server’s configuration. They own the bindings and access rules.
form.invalid: Start with a capital letter and use capital letters, digits and underscores, such as STAGING_API_KEY.
form.takenNotice: Existing secret: {{name}}. To rotate it, use Replace value on the existing secret.
form.missing: Save unavailable: enter a name and a value.
form.takenReason: Save unavailable: the name is taken in {{environment}}.

rotation.title: Replace value
rotation.subtitle: {{name}} in {{project}} / {{environment}}. The new value replaces the stored one.
rotation.hint: The stored value is replaced and cannot be restored. The new value is hidden after saving.
rotation.notice: Tools that use this secret get the new value from their next call. The keychain keeps one value per secret, so the old one is gone once you save.
rotation.missing: Replace unavailable: enter a new value.
rotation.question: Replace the credential these resources use?
rotation.reason: A new credential may give these tools or MCP servers access to more external data or actions. Only you can confirm this change.

archiving.title: Archive {{name}}?
archiving.mixed: {{count}} tools and MCP servers use it: {{names}}. An archived secret gives no value to what uses it.
archiving.tool: 1 tool uses it: {{names}}. An archived secret gives no value to what uses it.
archiving.tools: {{count}} tools use it: {{names}}. An archived secret gives no value to what uses it.
archiving.server: 1 MCP server uses it: {{names}}. An archived secret gives no value to what uses it.
archiving.servers: {{count}} MCP servers use it: {{names}}. An archived secret gives no value to what uses it.
archiving.unused: No tool or MCP server uses it.

secrets.rowArchived: Archived · gives no value to what used it ({{uses}})
secrets.rowArchivedUnused: Archived · no tool or MCP server uses it
secrets.footer: Values live in this computer's secret store and are never shown again. A secret goes only to the tool, MCP server or connection bound to it, never into a prompt.
